prompt: Discuss three principles of public administration and their relevance to the Nigerian civil service.
model_answer: Expect: accountability, transparency, rule of law, impartiality/neutrality, efficiency — any three well explained with Nigerian public-service relevance.

prompt: Explain the process of a training needs assessment and why it matters for management development.
model_answer: Expect: identify performance gaps, gather data (surveys/appraisals), analyse, prioritise, design training; matters because it targets real gaps and justifies budget.

prompt: Outline the key stages of the government budgeting process.
model_answer: Expect: preparation/call circular, drafting by MDAs, executive consolidation, legislative appropriation, implementation/warrants, monitoring, audit.
